explanation: The block no longer follows an open v-if chain, so plugin overrides that start with v-else-if or v-else no longer compile.
fix: keep the v-if element directly before the block.

explanation: The template variable item from a v-for is no longer available in block sw_example_card_list_item, so plugin overrides that use item fail at render time.
fix: pattern "Scope variable removal". Keep item available in the block while v6.8.0.0 is off, and mark the block {# @bc-change ScopeVariableRemoval version:v6.8.0 variable:item #}.

explanation: The v-if chain of block sw_example_card_header_title continues in block sw_example_card_header_label_manual, so overriding sw_example_card_header_title without {% parent %} leaves the v-else-if without its v-if.
fix: keep the whole chain inside one block.

explanation: The CSS class sw-example-card__list is no longer in the template, so plugin styles and selectors that use it stop matching.
fix: mention it in the upgrade notes if plugins are likely to style it.
